name: QyLock - Themed lock and Live Backgrounds for Omarchy
author: Mark
description: Themed lock and live backgrounds for Omarchy: downloads lock screen and SDDM themes from a compatible git repository (qylock-style), lists them in a menu together with Omarchy's own wallpapers and your drop-in folder, and applies your pick: themed lock + SDDM login theme, and image/video/GIF backgrounds (animated when the live-background renderer is active).
